name: Dirgur Stronghold
description: The Jeskai stronghold where the five khans meet and are attacked by dragons.

timeline.summary: Shu Yun dictates a history of Tarkir at Dirgur and prepares to receive the arriving khans at his unprecedented summit.
timeline.quote: This meeting, this council of khans, was Shu Yun's desperate effort to improve the odds of survival.

pages_say.description: A Jeskai stronghold on an island in a lake, closest to the Salt Road, where the summit is held and attacked.
The Jeskai stronghold where the five khans meet and are attacked by dragons.
